$comment: Pages that once existed and where a reader holding their address is sent now. `from` is the old path in canonical (unprefixed) form; a trailing /* carries whatever followed it onto the new path — and must not share its head with a page that still exists, since the rule would catch that page's own address too (the old per-exercise rhythm trainer is left out for that reason). Read by dev/gen-redirects.mjs at deploy.
